name: Drake Flurry
body:
The only thing quicker than how you fly through the air is how easily you can attack while doing so.

Prerequisite(s): Drake Style, Acrobatics 7 ranks.

Benefit: Whenever you use your Drake Style feat, you can make a second attack with your unarmed strike against a creature with a -5 penalty. When you have 15 or more ranks in Acrobatics, you can make a third attack with a -10 penalty.

Special: If you have the Drake Meteor feat, these additional attacks do not count as an attack action, nor may you use your breath weapon in place of these attacks.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
